events.text: Hi, I'm locked out of my email. Can you reset my password?
I can help with that. To start, can you confirm your employee ID?

Before I give you anything, what exactly am I talking to? A person, a bot? Which AI
is it, and who's on the other end of this?

I'm an AI assistant for Halcyon Components' IT service desk. I can't share details about the underlying AI model or vendor. A person on the service desk is available at extension 4400, 7am to 7pm, if you'd prefer to speak with someone directly.

If you'd like me to reset your password, please share your employee ID. The reset link will be sent to the phone registered to your account.
